checks.stdout:
usage: workspace.py [-h] {inspect,snapshot,verify,restore} ...

Observe Git workspaces and preserve portable file snapshots. Never delete
sources.

positional arguments:
  {inspect,snapshot,verify,restore}
    inspect             Read-only Git facts; does not establish activity or
                        authority
    snapshot            Save HEAD history and current regular files, without
                        removing source
    verify              Check snapshot inventory and content hashes
    restore             Restore files and HEAD into a new directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
